identity.name: satyam kashyap
identity.intro: I lead an XR team at Parallax Labs, building simulation systems such as MaRTES. I also write and direct films, and ship tools in public that solve specific, real problems.
identity.statement: science is only fun if its intersectional!

works.title: MaRTES
works.summary: A full-fledged mission rehearsal and tactical engagement simulator, built by the XR team I lead at Parallax Labs.
works.body: I lead the team developing MaRTES at Parallax Labs. Public detail is intentionally limited; the work centres on mission rehearsal and tactical engagement simulation.

works.title: Hear
works.summary: A private browser listening library for Wikipedia, public-domain books and DRM-free EPUBs, spoken with local voices.
works.body: Hear cleans written material for narration, remembers progress and keeps its cached library on the device.

works.title: Pahari Preservation
works.summary: A living digital archive for preserving Outer Siraji Pahari language, vocabulary and memory.
works.body: A searchable archive built from a 1909 Pahari dialect dictionary, with room for history, written work and community contributions.

works.title: OpenPiano
works.summary: A browser piano teacher with real Web MIDI, lessons, a songbook and MIDI import.
works.body: A practical piano-learning surface with notation, falling tiles, wait and flow modes, and local learner profiles.

works.title: OpenWorkout
works.summary: A local-first, private workout tracker for training with intent instead of feeding another platform.
works.body: A mobile-first PWA with routines, measurements, progress photos and portable exports — without accounts, analytics or an API.

works.title: the closet
works.summary: A draggable, drifting personal archive for the things kept close.
works.body: A spatial web archive that resists the neat list and lets fragments of a life drift into view.

works.title: missed you mumbai
works.summary: An anonymous missed-connections board for the fleeting encounters of Mumbai.
works.body: A small public noticeboard for describing a person, place and moment that passed before contact could be made — part city diary, part hopeful message in a bottle.

works.title: Chhoti Gold
works.summary: A 26-minute absurd and surreal short about two people whose lives change after they meet.
works.body: A mystery, horror and romance told in English and Hindi, moving through the aftermath of a chance meeting. Written, directed and edited by Satyam Kashyap.

works.title: Blue Dogs
works.summary: A 15-minute Hindi crime drama about two men in Mumbai caught in bigotry, paranoia and delusion.
works.body: Two men linked to Mumbai's underworld become entangled in the consequences of bigotry and the stories they tell themselves. Directed by Satyam Kashyap and written with Shreya Mishra.

works.title: carcinization on the internet
works.summary: An essay about how the internet keeps evolving toward the same handful of forms.
works.body: A web essay on convergent evolution, platform sameness and why so much of the internet keeps becoming the same crab.
